steps.what: Define the applied research question, industrial exposure pathway and species protection, restoration or reintroduction outcome
Conduct applied research by collecting or verifying actual species, habitat and industrial-process observations under the research design
Arrange comparable observations and calculate explicit exposure or species-response summaries in {SPREADSHEET}
Assess the effects of industrial processes on species and ecological interventions, checking uncertainty, confounding and limits of inference
Write and check the actual research findings and methodological limits in {DOCS}
Save the checked applied research record in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure reusable observation-grouping and explicit summary formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The ecologist designs and conducts the research, captures actual observations and interprets species effects; the change reduces repeated data arrangement, not fieldwork or causal judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable species and process observations can require repeated arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native grouping and formulas can repeat a declared analysis specification.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, detection uncertainty and attributing ecological change.
tasks.human_edge: Scientific design and critical ecological interpretation.

ambition.what: No expanded species inventory or research programme is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less summary assembly, unchanged research authority.

evidence.claim: Explicit ecological observation summaries can be calculated while research design, actual capture and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes applied research and its actual record, not implementing habitat intervention. The illustrated occurrence includes field observations; a desk-research occurrence must retain its actual source-reading effort instead, without a fieldwork saving.

The ecologist supplies species, site, time, method, observed count or condition, exposure evidence and uncertainty during s2, fully counted. Existing process records supply actual period, quantity and unit. Missing or incompatible observations are manually checked in retained s3 effort.
Native formulas first. Only grouping and arithmetic change, not observation validity or causal interpretation. Final author check in s5 binds the saved record. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Actual research methods and current summary reuse.
research_questions: Can configured summaries preserve sampling effort and detection limits?

already_counted.description: Research design, actual capture and ecological interpretation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain grouping and method-aware summary formulas.

approvals.approved_version: Exact research record checked in s5; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35% less summary assembly on 20 share saves 7 points less 1 upkeep. Low is existing summaries or incomparable observations; no research or field capture saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct scientific habitat-protection and restoration projects.

steps.what: Translate the approved scientific protection, mitigation or restoration plan into actual implementation priorities and checks
Conduct scientific protection, mitigation or restoration projects through actual site coordination, observation and intervention oversight to protect critical habitats
Write and check the actual project progress record, ecological exceptions and follow-up in {PROJECT}, reusing site and work-package identity
Save the checked ecological progress record in {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Configure site and work-package fields in the existing project record {PROJECT}. The ecologist conducts the actual protection or restoration work and records observed outcomes; repeated identity fields change, while site judgement and corrective direction remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project progress entries can repeat site and work-package identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project-linked forms can reuse identity without assuming ecological completion.
tasks.still_hard: Protecting habitat under changing site conditions.

ambition.what: No new project coverage or faster ecological recovery is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less progress-record repetition, unchanged field responsibility.

reach.learn: Distinguish activity completion from habitat outcome.

evidence.claim: Native project fields can reuse identity, but ecological intervention outcomes require actual observation and judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is conducting the project and its actual progress record. Earlier ecological plan design, procurement and other crews' physical execution are not repeated or credited as focal savings.

Project administration supplies site ID, work-package ID and approved plan revision. The ecologist captures actual activity, date, observed condition, outcome and exception in s2-s3, fully retained apart from repeated identity. Missing outcomes are manually checked, never inferred from scheduled completion.

Native forms first. Only repeated identifiers and headings in s3 change; substantive progress writing, scientific judgement and fieldwork remain. Normal author check in s3 binds the exact saved record; no separate self-approval step is added.
unknowns: Existing linked fields and actual progress-writing requirements.
research_questions: Can linked records preserve the difference between completed work and actual habitat recovery?

already_counted.description: Implementation direction and actual project fieldwork remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact progress record checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15% less identity entry in 24 share saves 3.6 points less 0.8 upkeep. Low is native identity already linked; no intervention or ecological recovery saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate environmental accidents and assess ecological impact.

steps.what: Read the actual incident report, site context and evidence restrictions before investigating the accident
Investigate accidents affecting the environment through actual site inspection and capture of ecological observations and evidence
Interview actual witnesses and operators to clarify timing, conditions and uncertain accounts
Arrange actual timestamped evidence and sample results into a native incident chronology in {DOCS}, keeping disputed times explicit
Assess ecological impact by evaluating exposure pathways, observed harm, alternatives and uncertainty
Write and check actual investigation findings, unresolved evidence and ecological-impact limits in {DOCS}
Save the checked investigation record in the restricted repository {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure native chronology sorting in {DOCS} over actual timestamped evidence. The ecologist performs the investigation, records witness accounts, assesses ecological impact and writes findings; chronology assembly does not resolve conflicting testimony or determine causation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual evidence can require repeated chronological arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured tables can sort explicit timestamps while retaining uncertainty.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, missing evidence and ecological causation.
tasks.human_edge: Investigation skill and caution about unsupported conclusions.

ambition.what: No faster investigation closure or automatic blame is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less evidence arrangement, unchanged investigative responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native evidence tables can sort explicit timestamps, while accident investigation and ecological impact assessment remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes investigation, actual evidence capture and its written record, not emergency response, public notification or regulatory submission. No send is hidden in saving the record.

The ecologist captures actual observation and witness account in s2-s3. Existing incident and laboratory records supply evidence ID, actual timestamp, time zone, sample ID and result; uncertain times remain qualified. Manual capture and reference checking remain within s2-s4; no free transcript or extraction is assumed.

Native tables first. Only repeated chronological arrangement changes; interpreting events, interviews, sitework and findings writing remain full. The normal final check in s6 binds the exact saved record.
unknowns: Availability of reliable timestamps and existing chronology tools.
research_questions: Can native sorting preserve disputed timing without suggesting false certainty?

already_counted.description: Site investigation, interviews and ecological impact judgement remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain chronology fields and evidence links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact investigation record checked in s6; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 40% less chronology arrangement on 15 share saves 6 points less 1 upkeep. Low is a native chronology already present or unstructured evidence requiring manual handling.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze maximum useful work from system energy.

steps.what: Define the industrial or waste-treatment system boundary, reference environment and thermodynamic assumptions for maximum-work analysis
Verify actual energy flows, material composition, temperature, pressure and units against process records
Conduct analyses to determine the maximum amount of work for the given energy using explicit thermodynamic balances and property calculations in scientific analysis software {OTHER}
Interpret physical limits, losses and sensitivity and write and check the final maximum-work analysis against balances and assumptions
Save the checked maximum-work analysis in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure reusable thermodynamic balances and unit checks in scientific analysis software {OTHER}. The ecologist sets the reference conditions, verifies actual inputs and interprets the maximum-work result; solver runtime is excluded and no live process command is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated balance and property calculations can consume setup time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native solvers can reuse explicit equations and checked units.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing defensible boundaries and interpreting ideal limits against actual processes.
tasks.human_edge: Thermodynamic judgement and recognizing an invalid simplification.

ambition.what: No actual energy recovery or production improvement is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation assembly, unchanged scientific authority.

reach.learn: Reference states and actual process losses.

evidence.claim: Explicit thermodynamic balances and property calculations can use native solvers, while boundaries and physical interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is offline maximum-work analysis and its record, not changing an operating plant or claiming measured recovered energy. No physical process time enters the labour saving.

Plant records supply actual flow, composition, temperature, pressure, energy, unit and period. The ecologist verifies these in s2 and supplies reference conditions and equations in s1-s3. Missing measurements require manual confirmation in retained work; planned values are not actual.

Native solvers first. Only repeated setup and arithmetic change; equation choice, input verification and final physical interpretation remain full. Normal final check in s4 binds the saved analysis. Estimates are provisional.
unknowns: Existing solver setup and completeness of actual state measurements.
research_questions: Can reusable balances pass unit, conservation and limiting-case checks without hiding changed boundaries?

already_counted.description: Boundary choice, actual-input verification and final physical interpretation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain balance templates and property-data mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact maximum-work analysis checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 55% less setup and calculation on 35 share gives 19.25 points less 1.5 upkeep. Low is already reusable solver setup or missing actual state data; no physical energy benefit claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit calculation and evidence tools while retaining fieldwork and scientific interpretation.
reach: Explain ecological and thermodynamic evidence limits to conservation and energy specialists.
role.ambitious_version: An ecologist whose research and resource analyses remain tied to actual observations and explicit assumptions.
